bitcoin_articles.headline: Bitdeer Continues Bitcoin Liquidation Strategy with Sale of 201.6 BTC
bitcoin_articles.summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group sold 201.6 BTC this week, maintaining its ongoing strategy of liquidating mined Bitcoin to support operational liquidity and expansion.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) Records Net Outflows
bitcoin_articles.summary: BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) experienced $68.9 million in net outflows on May 22, 2026, as part of broader institutional selling pressure on spot Bitcoin ETFs.
